problem_or_trigger: A finite control search did not pass.
principle: A nonpassing finite search is an observation about its parameterization, initialization and allowance, not a verified exclusion of the structure.
assumptions: Check the frozen model, input binding and method admission.
applicability: Model-based tendon-robot research; cross-task transfer unverified.
diagnostic_questions: Are physical input saturation and algorithmic limits distinguished?
possible_actions: Compare a changed control parameterization at a matched condition.
Inspect residuals or a model-supported structural contrast if control changes no longer discriminate.
expected_observations: Improvement under a changed parameterization weakens the structural-limitation explanation.
Repeated limited failures alone still do not prove infeasibility.
cannot_conclude: A guaranteed benefit from more compute
validation_status: Conditional method; no cross-task success guarantee.
